metadata.scenario: A man calls for the first time asking about speech therapy services for his mother who had a stroke. He asks about frequency, duration of sessions, and cost. The receptionist provides a quote for twice-weekly sessions at $95 each. He sounds hopeful and wants to start next week. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Frank Miller. I'm calling about speech therapy services for my mother. She recently had a stroke. I'm sorry to hear about your mother, Frank. We can definitely help with that. Great! Can you tell me about the frequency and duration of the sessions? Certainly! We typically recommend twice-weekly sessions for about 45 minutes each. Okay, that sounds good. What’s the cost for those sessions? Each session is priced at $95. So, for twice a week, it would be $190 weekly. That’s manageable. When could we start? We can schedule your mother's first session as early as next week. Would you like to book a specific day? How about Monday? That works for me. Let me check our availability... Yes, we have an opening on Monday at 10 AM. Does that suit you? Yes, that’s perfect! Great! I’ll go ahead and reserve that slot. Can I have your mother's name, please? Her name is Martha Miller. Thank you, Frank. Do you have any specific goals for her speech therapy? Yes, we want to focus on improving her clarity of speech and maybe some basic conversation skills. That sounds like a solid plan. I can pass this information along to our therapist. Perfect, thank you. Is there anything else I need to do? Just to confirm, I'll need your contact number for our records. Sure, it’s +13165552891. Got it. Now, would you be interested in discussing additional services like personal care or transportation? Maybe later, but I’d like to focus on the speech therapy for now. Absolutely, Frank. I’ll have our therapist reach out before the first session to discuss everything. That sounds great, thank you so much, Margaret. You’re welcome, Frank! Looking forward to helping your mother. Have a great day! You too, bye! Bye!
